newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to market Uzi in U.S. after 10-year ban.
newsitem.headline: Israel to market Uzi in U.S. after 10-year ban.

text.p: Israel has received approval to market its Uzi semi-automatic rifle in the United States after a 10-year ban, an Israeli official said on Tuesday.

The official, who declined to be identified, confirmed a report in the Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper that Israel Military Industries had developed a model of the Uzi that fires only single rounds and cannot be converted to an automatic weapon.
The United States banned import of automatic weapons in 1987 after they were used in a rash of crimes, the newspaper said.
It took IMI and its American subsidiary a year to get approval from the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms for marketing the Uzi, the report said.
